external_games.name: Guānyú Sīmén Shì de Yīxiē Chuányán

name: Guānyú Sīmén Shì de Yīxiē Chuányán
summary: A game in visual novel format, collecting fourteen fantastical horror short stories. From submissions to a website column, a club's horror story sharing event, to secret experiments conducted inside a certain facility… You will explore the various strange rumors surrounding Simen City from different perspectives.
